_doc: #1160 the nav-icons guard's declarations (1_cicd/src/scripts/cloud-android-nav-icons-guard.py). catalog: where the one icon catalog lives. semantic: names it must hold. entry_points: the only calls that build nav items in an Android source. lib_apps: a shared lib that holds an app's nav declaration, mapped to the app whose build.json declares the icons. exceptions: a nav declaration file that may not draw its glyphs from the catalog, each with the reason; an exception for a file that no longer exists, or that already passes, is stale and fails (it cannot outlive its reason).

exceptions.ac_cloud-vault/app/src/main/kotlin/com/x: Bitwarden fork: each tab's label, icon and route stay the upstream VaultUnlockedNavBarTab's (a patched upstream file); it is on the legacy BottomNavHost until the fork's tabs move to the catalog.
